can you imagine it?

Why would I be? You're wonderful.

So you've come,

At Medoekia, the village below this castle,

en: use his vast power to destroy humans and us.
It took our whole clan to subdue
and we sealed him away in a certain tower.
But lately, the power of the seal has been
weakening rapidly.
In that last battle, our clan used up nearly
all the power it had, and we have no means
left to stand against him.
Except for you, that is.
Of all of us, you have inherited one of the
greatest powers: the power, held only by the
direct Eisen line, to wield "Critical Vitality".
Critical Vitality?
For us, drinking blood means keeping our
eternal life, but for the direct line, it means
more than that.
By using humans to nurture Critical Vitality,
you can gain greater fighting strength and
healing power.
Using Critical Vitality, you can do what we
could not 150 years ago, and erase
from this world.
This is urgent, so leave here at once.
I'll have Rusalie guide you
to Medoekia village.
